# How to connect SE Ranking MCP to Gemini Spark

SE Ranking MCP gives you access to live SEO and AI search data in Gemini Spark through plain-language prompts.

It connects as a custom app with no coding or local installation required.

***Note:** Gemini Spark and custom connected apps are currently in beta and have limited availability.*

---

Custom connected apps are currently available only in English on the [Gemini web app](https://gemini.google.com/) and mobile app. For current requirements, see Google’s guide to [connecting custom apps to Gemini Spark](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137).

### Step 1: Open the Connected Apps settings

1. Go to [gemini.google.com](https://gemini.google.com/) and sign in.
2. Switch to **Spark**.
3. Select **Connected Apps** from the sidebar.
4. Scroll down to **Custom apps for Spark**.
5. Click **Add a custom app**.

![spark-custom-app-steps.png](https://help.seranking.com/hc/article_attachments/29963920078236)

### Step 3: Link your Google Account

 Link your Google Account to the SE Ranking custom app.

1. Sign in to your Google Account if prompted.
2. Review the requested permissions.
3. Click **Agree and continue**.

The permissions allow Gemini to:

- Execute SE Ranking MCP tools.
- Retrieve data needed for your requests.
- Share relevant prompt information with SE Ranking MCP.

### Step 4: Authorize access to SE Ranking

 You’ll be redirected to the SE Ranking authorization page.

Choose an authorization method:

- **Sign in with SE Ranking** — recommended.
- *Enter API keys manually — alternative method.*

For the recommended option:

1. Click **Sign in with SE Ranking**.
2. Sign in to the SE Ranking account you want to connect.
3. Approve the authorization request.

 Gemini uses data and API credits from the connected account.

![sign-in-with-se-ranking.png](https://help.seranking.com/hc/article_attachments/29965816935964)

### Step 5: Save the custom app

 Gemini opens the **Save your custom app** window.

1. Review the generated app name. Optionally rename it `SE Ranking MCP`.
2. Check the available functions.
3. Click **Connect**.

 You don’t need to select functions individually.

### Step 6: Verify the connection

Create a new task in Gemini Spark and enter:

***Example:** "Show me the organic and paid search stats for seranking.com across all countries. Use SE Ranking MCP."*

 Gemini should use SE Ranking MCP and return organic and paid search metrics.

![mcp-test-query-output.png](https://help.seranking.com/hc/article_attachments/29966216678300)

## Current limitations

For current eligibility and account requirements, see Google’s guide to [connecting custom apps to Gemini Spark](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137).

SE Ranking MCP requests use API credits. Available functions may change as new tools are added.

## Troubleshooting

| Issue | Resolution |
|---|---|
| **I don’t see “Custom apps for Spark”** | Check eligibility and account requirements in [Google’s official documentation](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137). Access may not yet be available for your account. |
| **Gemini can’t connect to the MCP server** | Make sure the full URL is entered without extra spaces: `https://api.seranking.com/mcp` If the error continues, remove the app and reconnect. |
| **Gemini uses the wrong SE Ranking account** | Remove the app and reconnect while signed in to the correct SE Ranking account. |
| **Gemini doesn’t use SE Ranking for my request** | Add this instruction to your prompt: `Use SE Ranking MCP.` |
| **The query returns an API credit error** | Check that the connected account has available API credits. MCP uses credits from your subscription or pay-as-you-go API plan. |

Need help? Contact [support@seranking.com](mailto:support@seranking.com).

## What’s next

Use SE Ranking MCP to:

- ✔Find keyword opportunities.
- ✔Compare organic competitors.
- ✔Analyze backlink gaps.
- ✔Review website audit issues.
- ✔Compare AI search visibility.
- ✔Build recurring SEO workflows.
